title: Vitamin IV drip
what: A solution of vitamins and minerals is given through a drip into a vein.
why: A doctor orders it for a proven vitamin shortage that cannot be fixed with food and pills. For energy and beauty, the benefit of these drips is not proven.
tell_doctor: All vitamins and supplements you already take

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: It is good to have blood tests before the drip, so the doctor can see what you are really missing.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: It is usually better not to come hungry.

bring: Test results, if you have them
A list of your medicines and supplements
steps: The doctor asks about your health and checks the order
The nurse puts an IV line in a vein
You sit or lie down until the solution runs out
The IV line is removed, and a cotton pad is pressed on
feel: A cool feeling along the vein
Sometimes warmth or a taste in the mouth
after: You can go about your day right away
A small bruise at the IV site goes away on its own
red_flags: A rash, a swollen face, trouble breathing, or sudden weakness: call emergency services
The arm along the vein becomes red, swollen, and painful

faq.q: Is it better than vitamin pills?
faq.a: Usually not, unless you have a condition where vitamins are poorly absorbed. Ask your doctor if you need a drip.

faq.q: Can I get too many vitamins?
faq.a: Yes, some vitamins build up in the body. That is why you should tell your doctor about all your supplements.

reminders.text: IV drip today. Eat something and bring a list of the vitamins and supplements you take.
